in_marathi.name: Adhir
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who is unstoppable
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adhir हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘adh’ meaning ‘towards’ and ‘hr’ meaning ‘to reach’. The name Adhir signifies one who is unstoppable, one who reaches towards his goal no matter what.
